findings.why: Heat H-4471 needs an EN 10204 3.1 certificate showing EN AW-6082-T6 and a yield strength of at least 250 MPa (SC-01). None of the documents contains a certificate or tensile result for this heat or lot. A person must supply it before the lot is released to production. Source approval AP-0311 covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL from Alluminio B on Rev C, so no source-release finding applies.
